## Incident / RCA / CAPA
- [ ] Incident ID linked (if applicable)
- [ ] Defect reproduced or reason reproduction is unavailable documented
- [ ] Confirmed facts separated from hypotheses; RCA confidence stated
- [ ] Hazard/severity assessment and affected scope documented
- [ ] Corrective action implemented
- [ ] Preventive action documented
- [ ] Regression test added

## Verification evidence
- [ ] Unit tests
- [ ] Integration / end-to-end tests (or justified not applicable)
- [ ] Lint / typecheck / build
- [ ] Security and authorization matrix reviewed
- [ ] Negative tests cover unauthorized and cross-project access
- [ ] Preview/runtime smoke test
- [ ] Independent reviewer verdict and evidence links recorded

## Risk / release controls
- [ ] No secrets or sensitive data in diff/logs/artifacts
- [ ] Rollback plan documented and tested where applicable
- [ ] Migration impact and rollback reviewed (or not applicable)
- [ ] Exact commit SHA and target environment recorded
- [ ] No merge, migration, or production deployment without explicit human approval
